title: cartierReduction existsUnique
statement: For n>0, a finite commutative ring A killed by n, an effective Cartier closed immersion i:D→Z and n invertible on Z, there are unique degree-two etale and pro-etale supported module Ext classes satisfying CartierEtaleReductionSpec and CartierProReductionSpec respectively [def-sfb-cartier-reduction-data].

source.place: Derived reduction, finite coefficient extension and canonical comparison paragraphs

proof.text: The supported etale integral coefficient generator is an unbounded derived scalar unit. Testing at a shifted Tate line gives bijectivity of its degree-two Ext scalar-adjunct map.

source.place: Derived reduction, finite coefficient extension and canonical comparison paragraphs

proof.text: Exact comparison is bijective on Ext. The coefficient-forgetting comparison and the canonical integral and module supported-source comparisons are isomorphisms. Transport the etale scalar-adjunct Ext bijection across this square to obtain the pro-etale bijection.

source.place: Derived reduction, finite coefficient extension and canonical comparison paragraphs

proof.text: For each bijection take the unique inverse image of the prescribed entire pole boundary followed by the normalized positive Kummer class. The two specifications are exactly these two equations. Full unbounded pro-etale scalar universality is not required for this existence-and-uniqueness step.

lean.statement:
theorem cartierReduction_existsUnique (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hA : (n : A) = 0) {D Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (i : D ⟶ Z) [IsClosedImmersion i] (hI : i.ker.IsInvertible)
    (hZ : IsUnit (n : Γ(Z, ⊤))) :
    (∃! c : Ext.{u + 1} ((Etale.lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) i).obj
        (Etale.ordinaryFiniteConstant A D)) (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine Z n A hA) 2,
      CartierEtaleReductionSpec A n hA i hI hZ c) ∧
    (∃! c : GeoCartierClass A n hA i,
      CartierProReductionSpec A n hA i hI hn hZ c)
